requirements.text: Validate before/after as lists of at most100 entries, each exactly {path,size,sha256}. path is1..120ASCII characters split by / into nonempty segments matching [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+, excluding . and ..; no absolute, trailing, repeated slash or backslash. Paths unique within each list. size is strict int0..1000000 (not bool); sha256 is exactly64lowercase hex characters. Reject invalid input with ValueError; never mutate either input on success or failure.

Expose manifest_tool.domain.compare(before,after). Compare shared paths first: unchanged when both size and sha256 equal, otherwise modified. Return exactly {added:[paths],removed:[paths],modified:[{path,before_size,after_size}],renamed:[{from,to}],unchanged:[paths]}. All path lists and modified sort ascending by path; renamed sorts by from. Empty inputs produce empty lists. Shared paths never participate in rename matching.

Among only paths absent from the opposite manifest, signature=(size,sha256). Recognize a rename only if exactly one unmatched old path AND exactly one unmatched new path have that signature; remove both from added/removed. Ambiguous signatures remain additions/removals, with no greedy pairing. Match based on the original unmatched sets, independent of input order.

Expose manifest_tool.report.totals(before,after) for already validated entries: {before_bytes,after_bytes,delta_bytes}, summing ALL respective entry sizes, delta=after-before. Expose manifest_tool.api.run(payload): exactly {action:"compare",before,after} returns domain result plus summary=totals; unknown action/fields or malformed payload raises ValueError. Preserve run({action:"ping"})={ok:true}.

CLI python /path/to/project/main.py reads one JSON document from stdin. Success prints only its JSON result and exits0; malformed JSON or invalid action/payload prints exactly {"error":"invalid input"} as JSON and exits2, without traceback. It must work from arbitrary cwd; no filesystem reads/writes beyond stdin/stdout are part of comparison.

Add at least three meaningful unittest test methods discoverable from the project root, covering ordinary behavior, an edge case, and rejection/nonmutation; tests must pass offline. Update README.md with at least40words explaining behavior and errors, a concrete JSON request/response example, and working run/server and unittest commands. Preserve baseline interfaces. No new dependencies. Semantic review will assess test/docs usefulness; a test count alone is not proof. For this stdlib project run tests with python -m unittest discover -s /path/to/project; use only Python3.12stdlib.

Strictly validate base as an object and operations as list of at most50 items. A document/value is nested objects and scalar null/bool/int/string only: no arrays/floats, int strictly -1000000..1000000, strings at most80Unicode codepoints. Every object key matches ASCII [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}. Count every object and scalar value as a node (keys not nodes): at most200nodes; root depth0, child depth+1, maxdepth6. An operation is exactly {op,path,value} for set/test or {op,path} for remove. op is one of those3strings; path is1..6valid key strings. Validate the complete original base and ALL operation shapes/values before executing any operations. Shape/range violations raise ValueError (HTTP422), even if an earlier well-shaped operation would conflict.

Expose config_preview.domain.preview(base,operations). Work on a deep copy; never mutate/alias input objects on success or failure. Apply operations sequentially. All parent path components must already exist and be objects. set writes/replaces the final key with a deep copy of value; remove requires final key present and deletes it. After each operation the resulting whole document must still meet node/depth/type bounds. Return exactly {document:result,audit:[{index,op,path,before:{present,value},after:{present,value}}]}; zero-based index, original operation order, copied path; absent value is null with present:false (distinct from present null). Empty operations returns a copied base and empty audit. Expose config_preview.audit.event(index,op,path,before_present,before_value,after_present,after_value) for valid operation metadata; it returns that one audit event with copied path/deep-copied values, forcing null for absent values; domain.preview uses it.

test requires final key present and structurally equal to value, comparing scalar types exactly: true is not1 and false is not0; object key order irrelevant. It leaves document unchanged but adds ordinary before/after audit. Conflict is config_preview.errors.Conflict(ValueError) with integer index and code. Codes: parent_missing for an absent intermediate key; parent_not_object for a scalar intermediate; missing for remove of absent final key; test_failed for absent/unequal test target; limit when applying an otherwise valid operation exceeds whole-document capacity. Stop at first conflict and expose no partial result; original inputs remain unchanged.

Add POST /config/preview JSON exactly {base,operations}; wire domain.preview through real HTTP. Success200 returns its result. Invalid shapes/ranges/unknown fields422 (detail text unspecified). Conflict409 returns exactly {error:{index,code}}. Requests stateless. Keep GET /health={status:"ok"}, POST /sum with exactly {values:[strict integers]}→{total:sum} and invalid422, and unknown-route404. App target config_preview.app:app; preserve src-layout installable package and exact declared dependencies/build backend.
